summary: Iteration-4 frontend retest for SlotNow web app after full visual redesign (navy #1E3A8A + orange #F97316 + cream), new roles (Admin, Service Assistant/Receptionist) and 4-role 2x2 login grid. 13 of 14 requested flows verified PASS; 1 flow partially verified (reschedule button reachable but no free slots after first booking, so 'Booking updated' toast could not be re-observed in this iter — the flow itself is unchanged since iteration 3 where it passed end-to-end). All new admin + receptionist + provider-assistants pages render cleanly; bottom-nav overlap fix continues to hold; login redesign matches the mobile-app spec (SVG clock+pin logo, navy Slot + orange Now wordmark, 2x2 role tiles, orange Continue CTA, top-right EN/हिं language pill). Minor issues: (a) Receptionist header shows 'Assisting —' (business name empty), (b) 4x 403 responses during receptionist bootstrap (non-blocking), (c) ProviderOnboarding <span> in <option> hydration warning still present.

ui_bugs.issue: Header renders 'ASSISTING —' with an em-dash instead of the linked provider's business name. Likely a missing field in /api/receptionists/me or frontend using an empty fallback. Spec required 'Assisting <business name>'.
React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (carry-over from iter 2 and 3). Non-blocking.

Nandi auto mobiles (c0c3cc13-bb9a-43d9-9211-a493717fb017) still has 0 open slots on all 14 upcoming dates. Vehicle field UI (booking-vehicle-reg / -model / -service-type) confirmed rendering fine (already verified iter 3), but end-to-end booking creation for automobile category cannot be exercised until availability slots are seeded.

integration_issues.issue: Four HTTP 403 responses observed on receptionist landing/refresh — likely calls to endpoints that require provider or admin scope (e.g., /api/queue/my-position, /api/bookings) being called by shared components for the receptionist role. Non-blocking (dashboard still functions), but noisy console errors + unnecessary requests.

Logging in as provider 8888800884 after clearing localStorage redirected to /provider/onboarding instead of /provider (previously onboarded in iter 2 tests). Onboarding likely uses linked_provider_id from server; verify /api/providers/me returns the previously onboarded record so login goes straight to /provider dashboard. This did not block testing (Assistants CRUD still worked — the provider-manage-assistants CTA is present on the onboarding page too).

action_items: MEDIUM: Populate the linked-provider business_name on ReceptionistDashboard header so it reads 'Assisting <business name>' (currently 'Assisting —').
MEDIUM: Investigate the 4x 403 API calls fired on the /receptionist route — either gate those hooks behind role checks or update endpoints to accept receptionist scope.
MEDIUM (product/data): Seed at least one availability slot for the Automobile provider (Nandi auto mobiles) or add a second automobile provider so end-to-end vehicle-reg booking can be validated.

MEDIUM: Provider 8888800884 was previously onboarded (iter 2) but after localStorage.clear() and re-login the app routes to /provider/onboarding rather than /provider. Verify /api/providers/me returns the persisted provider and that AuthContext.linked_provider_id is re-hydrated on OTP verify for existing providers.
LOW: Fix ProviderOnboarding category <option> to render the translated label without a <span> wrapper (React hydration warning).
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx role tile styling reads 'bg-forest-faint border-forest ring-forest/10' — the tokens are still named 'forest' although visually they now render navy blue (#1E3A8A). Consider renaming Tailwind tokens to 'navy' for readability, or ensure a single semantic naming convention is used across the codebase after the redesign.
Login.jsx handlePinLogin now explicitly calls navigate(homeForRole(res.user)) (ignoring location.state.from) — this matches spec (customer PIN login lands on /). Nice fix vs iter 3.

ReceptionistDashboard.jsx should probably fetch and display the provider business_name (currently blank/dash). Consider requesting it from the /api/receptionists/me or /api/providers/mine endpoint on mount.

AppShell.jsx bottom-nav overlap fix (bottom-[76px], max-w-[360px]) continues to hold for all 4 role variants (customer / provider / receptionist / admin) — elementFromPoint returns the SVG child for every nav pill.
Provider Assistants CRUD is clean; block/remove data-testids follow assistant-<action>-<id> pattern.

success_rate.frontend: 13 of 14 requested scenarios fully passing (~93%). Reschedule flow's confirm-toast could not be re-observed only because no additional free slots remained after the fresh booking; the reschedule button, date picker and confirm CTA all render/behave correctly. Automobile end-to-end still blocked by seed data (known).
